exposure: Ultrasound features (e.g., criteria length of the implantation portion (IMPL), height of the gestational sac or mass protruding above the uterine cavity line (GSUCL), residual myometrial thickness (RMT), anterior-posterior diameter of the gestational sac at the level of the niche (GSSH))
outcome: Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) prognosis (favorable, moderate, or poor prognosis)
cohort: 230 patients diagnosed with Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP).
finding: An integrated machine learning and linear scoring model, utilizing features like GSUCL, IMPL, and RMT, effectively predicts Cesarean scar pregnancy prognosis with high accuracy (AUCs of 0.939 and 0.917).
